# Document catalogue: what the agent knows

All 55 sources are stored in `library/sources/`, with searchable text in `library/text/<ID>.txt` (image excluded). They were downloaded from the official sites and checked on 23 Oct 2026. Quote from the text files and cite the ID.

Used by: R = `esma-rulebook`, C = `esgr-compliance-review`, M = `esgr-methodology-qa`.
